meta.title: About Happy Paws
meta.description: The story of Happy Paws Cat Rescue, a registered charity run by dedicated volunteers in Stockton, Birmingham and Banbury.

s1.p: Happy Paws Cat Rescue is a registered charity run by dedicated volunteers, looking after cats in Stockton, Birmingham and Banbury.
s1.alt: A woman sitting on a rug holding a dark cat, with a second cat walking along the sofa behind her

s2.p: “I’ve had a passion for helping cats all my life. Ever since I was a little girl, I would always try to help cats in need. I always dreamed of opening my own rescue when I got older, and now that dream is a reality.”
s2.p3: Our team is made up of dedicated volunteers who work tirelessly to ensure that every cat in our care receives the love and support they deserve. From rescuing strays to rehabilitating and rehoming them, we are committed to making a difference in the lives of cats in need.

s3.p2: We give every cat the care, time and quiet they need to recover. Foster homes are a vital part of this. [Add detail.]
s3.p3: We match each cat with the right family, and stay in touch long after they have gone home.
s3.p: We take in strays and cats in need. [Add a line on how cats come to us and where.]
